newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Q1 retail sales fall 56.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Q1 retail sales fall 56.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in the first quarter fell a real 56.9 percent from a year earlier due to high inflation and the fall in the lev, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures showed.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-MARCH JAN-FEB JAN-MARCH'96
Sales of foods fell a real 53.1 percent year on year in the first quarter while sales of non-foods declined a real 59.2 percent.
Sales of consumer goods declined 60.4 percent year on year in March as consumer price inflation stood at 2,041 percent year on year, the NSI said.

Retail sales however rose a real 26.9 percent month on month in March as monthly consumer price inflation slowed down to 12.3 percent from 242.7 percent in February and the lev stabilised around 1,600 to the dollar last month, up from 2,900-3,000 in February.
The lev traded near 70 to the dollar at the beginning of the year.
